about: Surfing Croyde Bay is a Surfing England Centre of Excellence run by Damon Beveridge, a former head coach for Team GB and England. It teaches at Croyde Bay in North Devon and offers daily lessons and longer development programmes for all ages and abilities, from first-timers to pros. Groups are kept small.
offers: Daily surf lessons for all ages and abilities
Taster sessions, day courses and multi-day courses
where: Hobbs Hill, Croyde, overlooking Croyde Bay
goodToKnow: No more than six students per coach
Hot showers, heated changing rooms, lockers and a cafe/bar on site
States it is a Surfing England Centre of Excellence
